remarks: This well-maintained 2-bedroom, 1 Bath unit features central air conditioning and a beautifully landscaped, level yard perfect for relaxing or entertaining. Conveniently located within walking distance to public transportation, SoNo Mall, West Avenue Shopping, the Stopping Stones Museum for Children, Lockwood-Mathews Mansion, and nearby parks. Easy access to I-95, the Merritt Parkway, train station, and bus station makes commuting a breeze. Don't miss this prime location in the heart of Norwalk!
